newsitem.title: USA: Fred Meyer comfortable with '97 estimates.
newsitem.headline: Fred Meyer comfortable with '97 estimates.

text.p: Fred Meyer Inc Executive Vice President Ken Thrasher said he was "very comfortable" with Wall Street estimates that the company will earn between $2.60 to $2.70 per share in the 1997 fiscal year.
The company is expected to report fiscal 1996 earnings on March 13 and Thrasher said he was comfortable with a Wall Street consensus estimate of $2.01 per share, compared with $1.07 in 1995.

Thrasher also told investors at a Piper Jaffray conference the retail chain would invest $190 million in capital spending a year in 1997 and 1998, compared with about $120 million in the fiscal year that just ended.
He also said the company plans to build five major new stores and do five major remodelings on existing stores in both 1997 and 1998.
